items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yeah, he got those recordings, I have some of them here, after he was in the insane asylum because they wouldn‟t let anybody go into the insane asylum. But Inky, being an official of the union got in there and got some of them and they‟re amazing, just to hear what he was doing. I got a chance to work with Cass Simpson.
